title: Understanding Residuals in OLS
text: In an Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression, the residuals have specific properties related to the design matrix and the predictions.

title: Residuals and the Design Matrix
text: Consider the relationship between the residuals and the columns of the design matrix. What does it mean for them to be orthogonal?

title: Sum of Residuals
text: Think about the sum of the residuals in the context of the regression model. What is a common property of this sum?

hintAnswer: They are orthogonal to the column space of the design matrix (X).
title: Orthogonality of Residuals
text: The residuals are orthogonal to the column space of the design matrix (X). This means that the dot product of the residuals and any column of X is zero.
choices: They are orthogonal to the column space of the design matrix (X).
Their sum is equal to the mean squared error.
Their sum is equal to zero.
They are orthogonal to the vector of predictions (hat{Y}).
